The Titanic set sail on April 10, 1912, departing from Southampton, England, on its maiden voyage to New York City [d2][d7][d8]. According to multiple sources, the ship cast off from the White Star Dock at approximately 12:00 noon, towed out into the River Test by tugboats [d1][d3]. The voyage nearly began with a collision when suction from the Titanic caused the docked New York to swing into its path, causing a brief delay before the liner was fully underway [d2]. After stops at Cherbourg, France on the evening of April 10 and Queenstown (Cobh), Ireland on April 11, the Titanic set its final course for New York [d2][d6].
